# sdd-start

Phase 0 of spec-driven development. Use when we ask for something in plain words (a feature, a CRUD, an idea, a fix), or ask "where are we?". Reads the whole requirements catalogue, maps the request to the RTs it serves (or marks it outside the catalogue), proposes the dossier, creates it and its branch, and reports the next gate.

Read `.agents/skills/sdd-start/SKILL.md` and follow it step by step. It is the canonical skill; this file only points to it.
